description: This Java source file defines the VoidSaveHandler class, which handles setting the voided attributes (voidedBy, dateVoided, voidReason) on objects that implement the Voidable interface when they are saved. It ensures these attributes are correctly populated or cleared based on whether the object is being voided or unvoided.

classes.name: VoidSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for managing the voided state of objects implementing the Voidable interface. It sets or clears voidedBy, dateVoided, and voidReason attributes based on the voided flag during save operations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles setting or clearing the voided attributes on a Voidable object depending on its voided state. If voided is true, sets voidedBy and dateVoided if not already set; if false, clears these attributes along with voidReason.
